item.title: Randall A. Hoffman
item.description: Randall A. Hoffman, 65, Churubusco, died unexpectedly Saturday, Jan. 24, 2026, in Churubusco. He was born Feb. 20, 1960, in Kendallville. He is survived by his children, Brandon Sheets and Brandi (Adam) Dammeyer; siblings, Brian Hoffman, Cindy (David) Fulk and Sherri Gaff; and three grandchildren. Sheets & Childs … Read More

item.title: ‘Postcards’ Concert Coming To The Lerner In Elkhart
item.description: The Lerner Theatre has announced the "Elkhart Municipal Band presents: Postcards" is coming to the historic Lerner Theatre at 3 p.m. Sunday, March 1.

item.title: Is Tonight A Full Moon? The Snow Moon Will Glisten Above Indiana Soon
item.description: In a "Gee, isn't that neat?" celestial coincidence, the Snow Moon will soon rise above Indiana a week after a winter storm dropped nearly a foot of snow over Indianapolis and its surrounding area.

item.title: Reed Family Farm Named River Friendly Farm By Elkhart County SWCD
item.description: The Reed Farms of Nappanee was named the 2025 River Friendly Farm by the Elkhart County Soil and Water Conservation District, Indiana Association of Soil and Water Conservation Districts and the State Soil Conservation Board.

item.title: Michigan City Teen Charged With Breaking Into A LaPorte County Prison
item.description: A teenager is accused of the latest attempt to smuggle a large amount of contraband ranging from drugs and tobacco to cell phones and super glue into a LaPorte County prison.
